title: Prompt Enhancer Test - Anima Sentence Cafe Scene

global.positive_source: Two people are sitting together in a cozy cafe. The scene should feel calm and detailed, with pleasant natural lighting.
global.negative_source: The image should not look blurry, distorted, unfinished, or low quality.

background.positive_source: The cafe has wooden tables and large windows. Warm light fills the room and creates a comfortable atmosphere.
background.negative_source: The background should not be empty, blurry, flat, or distracting.

prompts.positive_source: A woman with short black hair wears a red jacket. She sits calmly and holds a white coffee cup in her hands.
prompts.negative_source: She should not have blonde hair, a blue jacket, malformed hands, or the wrong cup.

prompts.positive_source: A man with curly brown hair wears a green sweater. He sits opposite the woman and has an open notebook on the table near him.
prompts.negative_source: He should not have straight black hair, a red sweater, malformed hands, or a missing notebook.

prompts.positive_source: A wooden table stands between them. The white coffee cup belongs near the woman, while the open notebook belongs near the man. Their hands remain visible.
prompts.negative_source: The cup should not appear near the man, and the notebook should not appear near the woman. Do not duplicate or mix up the objects.
